firstPlayerRule: The person who most recently visited outer space starts. If nobody has, the person who most recently watched or read something about space starts.
clarifications: The first-player token stays with that player for the entire game.
The token identifies where play stops after the end of the game is triggered.
internalEvidence: Downloaded the English booklet from Spielefaible and rendered page 3. Initial setup gives the outer-space criterion, its watch-or-read fallback and the instruction to retain the first-player token.
